Title: Marsh Lock Bridge - Henley
Description: Footbridge closed due to safety concerns. Diversion of 3 miles via A4155 and Harpsden.

Title: Sandford Footbridge - Oxford
Description: Unsafe footbridge north of Sandford Lock closed. Diversion via NCN 5.

Title: Abingdon Weir Walkway - Intermittent
Description: Closed intermittently due to high river levels and corrosion. Reopened 30 Sept 2025 with trigger-based closures.

Title: Temple Footbridge - Hurley
Description: Closed May 2023 for structural safety. Central section removed Nov 2025, beyond repair.

Title: Bridge 142 - Runnymede
Description: Closed February 2024 after tree strike. Diversion via A308. Repairs possible 2027.

Title: Bell Weir Lock - Diversion
Description: Small diversion around compound at Runnymede Pleasure Grounds for works.

Title: Streatley-Goring Towpath - Eroding
Description: 0.5 mile diversion due to eroding towpath. Repairs unlikely until late 2026.

Title: Penton Hook Island - Tree Safety
Description: Closed since February 2025 due to Ash Dieback disease. Tree clearance ongoing.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge - Faringdon
Description: Thames Path does not cross this bridge. No closure currently reported.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal - Redevelopment
Description: Left bank blocked between River Brent bridge and Marina. Partial reopening via The Ham to Thames Lock.

Title: Osney Bridge Diversion - Oxford
Description: Short riverbank repair diversion via Abbey Road and Botley Road.
